name: Financial Instrument Quantity 50 Choice
definition: Choice between formats for the specification of the number of units, amount of money or percentage.

UnitsNumber.name: Units Number
UnitsNumber.definition: Number of investment fund units redeemed.

PercentageOfTotalSubscriptionAmount.name: Percentage Of Total Subscription Amount
PercentageOfTotalSubscriptionAmount.definition: Percentage of the total switch amount (buy-driven) to be invested in a particular investment fund or investment fund class.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Amount of money to be received following redemption of fund units. |Net Amount = (Quantity * Price) - (Fees + Taxes).

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Amount of money to be redeemed from the fund. |Gross Amount = Quantity * Price.

DigitalTokenUnit.name: Digital Token Unit
DigitalTokenUnit.definition: Quantity of digital tokens expressed as a number, for example, a number of blockchain tokens.

HoldingsRedemptionRate.name: Holdings Redemption Rate
HoldingsRedemptionRate.definition: Portion of the investor's holdings to be redeemed.
